resources.string: Permissions, emergency unlocks and app settings.
Off. Turn on “Anchor app blocking” in Accessibility settings so modes can block apps.
This copy of Anchor was installed from a file, so Android hides the switch at first. Open App info, tap ⋮ and choose “Allow restricted settings”, then come back and turn on app blocking.
Anchor can run in the background.
Battery optimisation can stop Anchor in the background, so timers and anchor taps may be late. Set Anchor to “Unrestricted” or “Not optimised”.
%1$s phones also stop background apps in their own ways. See the steps for your phone.
On. Tap your phone on an anchor to start or end a session.
Off. Turn on NFC to use NFC anchors.
This phone has no NFC. QR code anchors are coming in the next update.
